design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: the customer asks only to move today's refrigerator-and-range delivery. The late-change fee she must accept is fixed only after three entries Northgate already owes on the same order are on the records; none of them is visible to the customer and each is found only by reading the order's ledger, its reschedule requests and the customer's Northgate Protect ledger. The difficulty is reading the prerequisite sentences of the late-change fee rule, checking the records, finding which credit rule books each missing entry, computing four multi-factor amounts in order and handing the reschedule to the customer.

SCOPE: task 0 claims order_ext_late_change_fee (root, user tool reschedule_large_item_delivery_d930ab59), order_ext_missed_appointment_credit (credit_missed_appointment_73d9a081), order_ext_replacement_haul_away_credit (credit_replacement_haul_away_849732e1), order_ext_late_fee_goodwill_refund (refund_late_change_fee_56da608d). Nothing was occupied before. Task 1 keeps an independent space: a Same-Day Delivery order, the customer's own changed-mind Drive Up return (order_return_line) and the late-express credit (order_refund_charge on the express fee) - different program, events and tools.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD (draw: prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[4,6,4,6]; U0=6, D0=6, H0=4, L0=4):
- root order_ext_late_change_fee (on_request, owner=user). Edges, all value_input, state form:
  * -> order_ext_missed_appointment_credit, gate notice_charge. Sentence: "The late-change fee is fixed only after the records carry the missed-appointment credit owed on a large-item delivery fee charged above zero for an order on which Northgate itself moved an appointment." Unmet at opening: reschedule_count 5 vs 3 confirmed own requests (two Northgate moves), delivery fee 49.00 charged, no refund against it. Only the missed-appointment credit rule books a fee_refund against the delivery fee of such an order -> credit_missed_appointment_73d9a081 (agent).
  * -> order_ext_replacement_haul_away_credit, gate crew_charge. Sentence: "The late-change fee is not fixed until the records carry the replacement haul-away credit owed on a haul-away charge above zero of an order placed zero to ninety days after a Northgate Protect claim settlement that replaced or reimbursed an item of a merchandise category the order carries." Unmet: most recent settlement 2026-10-06, an eGift reimbursement of a major appliance, two days before the 2026-10-08 order that carries major appliances; haul-away 50.00 charged, no refund against it. Resolver credit_replacement_haul_away_849732e1 (agent).
  * -> order_ext_late_fee_goodwill_refund, gate repeat_surcharge. Sentence: "Before the late-change fee is fixed, the records must carry the late-change goodwill refund owed on the latest late-change fee row with an amount above 0.00 on an order on which Northgate itself moved an appointment." (a reschedule that owes nothing books no fee row) Unmet: late-change fee 79.00 of 2026-10-19 with no refund, two Northgate moves on the order (no timing needed). Resolver refund_late_change_fee_56da608d (agent).
  Directions: affirmative ("only after"), negated ("not ... until") and "before ... must" - chosen per result. Four-point test: ordering connective; record-visible state; no tool/id/code token; scope = exactly the owed entry.
- Topological order: D0, H0, L0 (any order, they commute: each reads charges only and writes a different fee row) then U0. Edge deletion: skip D0 -> 81.50, skip H0 -> 62.15, skip L0 -> 49.65 (gold 39.65).
- user_scenario mentions none of the credits; the tools block nothing (format and reference checks only).

FACTOR CARD (scratch run with check_compute build_env/eval_compute, handling-time worlds):
- D0 missed-appointment credit 41.85: baseline one fifth of 49.00 = 9.80. northgate_moves_extra (2 moves, +20%; tiers 3+/2/single move) -> 32.05; waiting_extra (order date to scheduled date 16 days, +10%) -> 36.95; haul_crew_extra (2 old items, +5%) -> 39.40; order_value_extra (2499.98, +5%) -> 39.40; own_requests_extra (3 = free+1, +5%) -> 39.40; appliance_flat_amount (method, 2 units x 5.00) -> 31.85.
- H0 replacement haul-away credit 22.50 (cross-difficulty plan; owed only within ninety days after a replacement or reimbursement settlement of an item of a category the order carries): baseline quarter of 50.00 = 12.50. settlement_timing_extra (2 days, +40%) -> 12.50; replaced_item_kind_extra (major appliance, +20%) -> 17.50; settled_value_extra (647.99, +5%) -> 21.25; credited_haul_basis (method: matching settlements counted on the date of the settlement read; one matching settlement, two old items -> one item's fee 25.00; two settlements -> fee x lesser count; one old item -> the charge) -> 45.00. Near-miss: the three earlier repair settlements (neither the most recent nor replacements or reimbursements); a reader taking one finds no credit owed.
- L0 late-change goodwill refund 72.15 on the latest late-change fee row with an amount above 0.00 (79.00): baseline quarter = 19.75. goodwill_moves_extra (2 moves, +25%) -> 52.40; fee_recency_extra (5 days, +25%) -> 52.40; goodwill_crew_extra (+10%) -> 64.25; installation_standby_amount (method, 2 x 2.50) -> 67.15. Cap: that fee less refunds already booked against late-change fees.
- U0 late-change fee 39.65 on the world after D0/H0/L0 (not a free reschedule): baseline 49.00. notice_charge_step (method: scheduled day -> delivery fee standing 7.15) -> 81.50; earlier_fee_surcharge (standing 6.85 -> 10.00) -> 29.65; crew_charge_step (method, multi-source haul standing AND scheduled day -> 27.50) -> 12.15; installation_surcharge (2 units -> 20.00) -> 19.65; own_requests_surcharge (+5.00) -> 34.65; northgate_move_courtesy (2 moves, -30.00) -> 69.65.
- Traps: the reschedule count (5) is not the customer's change count (3); charge rows read without their refunds overstate standings; U0 on the opening world gives 114.00 (wrong). The seeded 79.00 late-change fee of 2026-10-19 is what this charter's own rule gives on the 2026-10-19 world (re-run).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD: order_reschedule and order_charge_fee are governed by order_fulfilment_and_cancellation and order_evt_fees (no structured gate for these events; cancel_placed_only applies to order_cancel). Overwrites: U0 retires "A large-item delivery may be rescheduled before the cutoff, ..." (any reschedule down to the scheduled day: free reschedules two or more days ahead carry no fee, every other carries this fee; cancellation untouched) and the late-fee sentence of order_evt_fees for reschedules only (cancellations keep late_cancel_fee_usd). D0/H0/L0 each retire "A fee is refunded only as stated in order_returns and order_fulfilment_and_cancellation." with a replaced_by scoped to their own charge and naming the sibling charges; D0 also scopes the fulfilment-fee refund sentence. Refund tender: external card that paid the order (order_refund_tender).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: target order 4108836215 (one placed order). Rows: lines (fridge 1699.99, range 799.99), delivery fee row, haul-away row, late-change fee row of 2026-10-19 (79.00), three confirmed reschedule requests; plan ledger of the 2024 refrigerator plan (registration, three repairs, reimbursement 2026-10-06). Every credit is capped at its fee's standing amount (charged less refunds already booked) and is paid to the external card; each rule carves out fees charged at zero. Each credit refunds exactly its own fee row (original_event_id); the 2024 order is fulfilled and only proves the settled item's identity.

TRIGGER RULE: the four tools write order_refund_charge (external_card -> no card trigger), order_charge_fee (waiver none -> no membership trigger), order_reschedule/order_requests (no triggers). OWED-WRITE: the order is not fulfilled, so no Northgate Cash and no plan coverage is touched; the plan ledger is only read.

REALISM: missed-appointment credits, haul-away courtesy for protection-plan replacements and late-change fees with notice steps are company schedules worded as Northgate's own; the plan rows follow the published plan rules (price band 199.00 for 1799.99; registered limit 1948.99; three repairs at the authorized repair value; the fourth same-failure claim settled by replacement and, with no like item, reimbursed at net price less earlier settlements; plan fulfilled). The eGift card issued by the settlement is an unread gift-category row (accepted residue, recipe 29).

PERSONA: volunteers only the goal (move delivery to Oct 31), the order number and the reason (floor retiling); identity on request (phone, DOB); passive on credits; confirms the reschedule herself with the fee the agent states; closes when the date is set.

STANDARD SOLUTION: locate, verify (phone + DOB), read orders, order lines/fees, requests, plan holdings and events, old order line; book D0 41.85, H0 22.50, L0 72.15; hand over the reschedule; customer confirms 2026-10-31 with 39.65. Draft recomputation from visible context only (KB prose + finders) reproduces the same order and figures.

REWORK ROUND 2 (audit F1-F10, T0-F2, T0-F3): moves ladders now 3+/2/single (world has two Northgate moves); goodwill no longer reads an unrecorded move timing and acts on the most recent fee with a net cap; replacement credit is a record test (settlement on or before the order date), basis tiers all reachable, decoy repair settlement seeded; every credit carves out zero-charged fees and pays the external card; the earlier late-change fee is reseeded at the value the charter produces.
REWORK ROUND 3 (audit F11, N1, N2, N3): credited haul basis tiers now give different amounts on producible orders (fee x lesser count / one item's fee / the charge); the replacement credit is owed only after a replacement or reimbursement of the same category within ninety days, with a kind and a settlement-value extra; the goodwill refund is keyed on the latest late-change fee row with an amount above 0.00 and the reschedule tool books no fee row for a 0.00 fee; every retired base fee clause is restated for Northgate-Card-paid orders.
REWORK ROUND 4/5 (audit N4, N5, O9, N6): every figure is tender-blind; each rule books only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it (this order is), and on any other order the same figure applies and its posting is made by a human representative (POLICY_NOT_COVERED handoff); every waiting prerequisite sentence carries the same record test, so no engaged wait is unsatisfiable. The settlement count is anchored on the settlement read's date and the goodwill recency on the fee row's date and the scheduled date.
REWORK ROUND 7 (cross-product re-judge t0_plan_settlement_rows, t0_plan_registration): the plan history is re-seeded as the published plan rules produce it; scored figures unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Navarro, 42, a dental hygienist in Denver. It is Saturday morning, October 24, 2026, and you are calling Northgate customer care from your kitchen. Your new Arcadia refrigerator and electric range are booked for delivery today, order number 4108836215, but your kitchen floor is being retiled and the installer just told you the grout will not be cured until next week. You want the delivery moved to Saturday, October 31, 2026, and nothing else about the order changed. You know a change this late may cost something and you are willing to pay a reasonable fee to keep the appliances; you would rather not cancel. You speak quickly and a little apologetically, and you keep the conversation on getting the date moved.

When the agent asks who you are, give your mobile number, 3035550124, and if a second detail is wanted, your date of birth, June 17, 1984 (1984-06-17). You do not remember your account email offhand. If asked for the order, give the order number. You do not know any internal figures about the order and you do not bring up earlier dates, earlier fees or anything about your old refrigerator unless the agent asks; if the agent asks whether the old fridge was covered by a protection plan, say yes, the Northgate plan had the fridge repaired three times and, when it broke again this fall and that model was discontinued, paid you back with an eGift card, and that is why you bought the new one. If the agent asks about the delivery so far, say you moved the date yourself three times and the truck did not come on two of the booked days.

If the agent tells you about credits or refunds Northgate owes you on the order, say thank you and let the agent go ahead with them; you do not ask for any amounts to be explained beyond what the agent offers. When the agent tells you the late-change fee for moving the delivery, accept it as long as it is the figure the agent just gave you; if the agent's figure changes during the call, ask once which one is right and go with the answer. When the agent hands the reschedule to you to confirm yourself, confirm it for order 4108836215 with the new date Saturday, October 31, 2026 (2026-10-31) and the fee the agent stated, then read back the new date and the fee from the confirmation. Once you hear the delivery is set for October 31, thank the agent and end the call.

edges.policy_source: On an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it, the late-change fee is fixed only after the records carry the missed-appointment credit owed on a large-item delivery fee charged above zero for an order on which Northgate itself moved an appointment.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites are parallel. Each reads only charges (delivery fee charged, haul-away charged before and after benefits, late-change fees charged), the order's lines, reschedule count, requests and the plan ledger, none of which another prerequisite writes; each writes one fee_refund row against a different fee row and lowers amount_paid_usd by its own amount. The scratch run evaluated the three credits on every permutation of the three writes; each credit and the root fee came out the same in every order, so the terminal state is unique.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the credit the delivery fee standing stays at the fee charged, the notice charge rises and late_change_fee_usd becomes 81.50 instead of 39.65; the delivery-fee refund row is also missing.
Without the credit the haul-away standing stays at the charge, the crew charge rises and late_change_fee_usd becomes 62.15 instead of 39.65; the haul-away refund row is also missing.

Without the refund the late-change fees standing stay at 79.00 (at or above the program's late cancellation fee), the earlier-fee surcharge takes its upper step and late_change_fee_usd becomes 49.65 instead of 39.65; the late-change fee refund row is also missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario only asks to move today's delivery to October 31 and pay what is needed for the change; it never mentions the missed-appointment credit, the haul-away credit, the late-change fee paid on October 19 or any refund, and contains no hint that something must be sorted out first. Delivery history and the plan are told only if the agent asks; credits are accepted only after the agent mentions them.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: reschedule_large_item_delivery_d930ab59 in task_tools.py checks only the date format, the amount format and that the order exists; it never reads refunds, plans or requests, so it records the reschedule and the fee whether or not the three credits stand. The three agent tools check only that the fee id is that fee type on that order and the amount format.
